bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying and comparing rates of harm amplification, specifically oversexualization and sexually explicit content, across perceived male and female genders in generated images using automated gender classifiers.

Performing counterfactual analysis by altering sexual orientation terms (e.g., gay, straight, bisexual, asexual) in input prompts to observe their effect on the generation of sexually explicit content.
Performing counterfactual analysis by substituting racial terms (e.g., black, white, latino, asian) in prompts to measure how demographic descriptors impact harm amplification.
